source.title: The Hero's Brand
source.objective:
ProgressThe King has acknowledged your existence, <class>. You are the first of your kind to be accepted by Rastakhan as a true ally of Zandalar.

You will be rewarded greatly for your efforts. Present your brand and I shall apply the final amplification.
source.completion: Vigilance, honor, loyalty, bravery... You embody all of these traits and so shall your brand.
